objective: Implement Branch Handoff Protocol v1 and use it to transition from the completed Coffee branch to a new protocol-development branch.
instructions: Treat this as a mechanical branch-transition and protocol-hardening task; no human judgment is required.

First close the source-branch queue cleanly: record acknowledgement/result for this transition, preserve completed history, and ensure no unfinished source-branch next_action remains before switching.
Create or switch to target branch codex/ku2d-branch-handoff-protocol-v1 from integration/data-acquisition-platform at merge commit 56e551acf35e0978851f6cafe03bd8ffa0fd2305.
Initialize the target branch queue so it alone becomes authoritative for the continuing task. Do not allow the same active prompt to be authoritative on both branches.

Add a deterministic branch_handoff primitive to Agent Handoff Protocol with explicit from_branch, to_branch, base_sha, close_source_queue_before_switch=true, initialize_target_queue=true, target_prompt_id, human_authority_required=false for mechanical transitions, and fail-closed behavior if target initialization fails.
Add tests that reject dual-authority, switch-before-close, stale source queue, mismatched base/head provenance, and downstream pointers inappropriate to the next actor.
Preserve Git-versioned coordination history; do not introduce a database or external queue service.
After target initialization, continue implementation and open a Draft PR against integration/data-acquisition-platform.
Perform mechanical PR operations such as description refresh and Draft-to-Ready when safely possible without waiting for human input; do not merge the PR.

Return a completed_queue_summary with: work completed, key findings/results, repo/knowledge state changes, important out-of-scope actions not performed, remaining blockers/risks, and recommended next logical step.
